title: Graveyard Challenge (in case you missed it)
content: John Singer Sargent,Graveyard in the Tyrol,1914In case you missed the announcement, I'm inviting everyone to paint a graveyard on location in a limited palette of colors.Here's the original blog post with all the details.It's free to enter, and you can post your entries on theFacebook event page(where works are already appearing), and you can also informally share your work on Twitter or Instagram at the hashtag #graveyardpaintingchallenge.
